description: Request to download a Portable Format for Biomedical (PFB) file from a a table/view query result.

includeRowIdAndRowVersion.description: When 'true', the Entity.id field will be populated with the concatenation of: <row_id> + '_' + <row_version>. When false, the Entity.id field will be null.  The default value is 'true'.

entityName.description: Required. Used for the Entity.name field of each row.

fileName.description: Set the name of the resulting PFB file. An auto-generated name will be used if omitted.
